RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Seattle operates under a mayor-council form of government. The Mayor is elected citywide. The City Council has nine members; seven are elected by district, and two are elected at-large (Positions 8 and 9). Sara Nelson also serves as the Council President. There were minor discrepancies in some search results regarding District 2 and 5 council members, but the official Seattle.gov website was prioritized for accuracy.
